infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Jono uses your microphone to capture voice notes and have reflective conversations. All voice recording happens locally on your device - your recordings are never uploaded to external servers. You control what stays and what gets deleted.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Jono uses Apple's on-device speech recognition to transcribe your voice recordings into searchable text. This processing happens entirely on your iPhone using Apple Intelligence - your words never leave your device.

plugins.microphonePermission: Jono needs microphone access to record your voice notes and conversations. All recordings stay on your device and are never uploaded without your permission.
Jono needs microphone access for voice recording. All audio is processed locally on your device.
plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: Jono uses Apple's on-device speech recognition to transcribe your recordings. Your voice data is processed locally and never leaves your device.
